decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the installation of a new shopfront would preserve the visual amenity and public safety of the area and would not harm the Spring Grove Conservation Area.  The proposal accords with policies ENV B.1.1 (New development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and S.4.2 (Shop Front Design) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan (2003) and the Council's Think Access Guidelines.
description: Installation of new shop front to existing building.
